title: OneDrive: Prompt Gallery for Copilot in OneDrive on the web
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts match the roadmap, and Microsoft documents the licence-assignment path and PowerShell command it gives administrators. Its statements about unpublished gallery-specific settings, eligibility and saving behaviour remain appropriately narrow after independent searches.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe this OneDrive gallery specifically.
claims.quote: Searched: '571308 OneDrive', 'OneDrive Open Prompt Gallery', and 'OneDrive Prompt Gallery Copilot Open Prompt Gallery default licensing admin switch meter saving sharing'; read Learn Prompt Gallery and application-card pages. Neither describes this OneDrive gallery.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents a Prompt Gallery available within Microsoft Copilot or Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: The documented Copilot Prompt Gallery places Microsoft-curated prompts under Suggested.

claims.claim: The documented Copilot Prompt Gallery supports team sharing and has a Teams grouping.
claims.quote:
and by team (under Teams).

Copilot prompts can be saved and shared across teams using Prompt Gallery

claims.claim: Microsoft does not state whether the OneDrive gallery uses the same catalogue, saving and sharing as the documented Copilot Prompt Gallery.
claims.quote: Searched: 'OneDrive Prompt Gallery saved prompts sharing Substrate organizational prompts'; read Copilot Prompt Gallery, organizational prompts and application-card pages, plus OneDrive FAQ. None connects this OneDrive gallery to that catalogue or its saving and sharing.

claims.claim: Copilot in OneDrive already has document-interaction skills that the gallery helps users discover.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot in OneDrive is an innovative AI-powered assistant designed to help you interact with your documents by extracting information, comparing the key differences, summarizing files and generating insights.

claims.claim: No source states that this gallery changes existing Copilot in OneDrive behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: '571308 OneDrive' and 'OneDrive Open Prompt Gallery'; read roadmap description, Learn Prompt Gallery and application-card pages, and OneDrive FAQ. They do not describe replacement or alteration of existing file operations by this gallery.

claims.quote: Searched: 'OneDrive Prompt Gallery default enable availability'; read roadmap, Copilot settings, Prompt Gallery and OneDrive FAQ. The FAQ says Copilot in OneDrive is always on for licensed users, but does not state this gallery's default or eligibility.

claims.claim: The Microsoft Copilot in SharePoint licence item must also be enabled for the OneDrive integration.
claims.quote:
Microsoft Copilot in SharePoint

Integration with SharePoint in Microsoft 365 and OneDrive is a core feature in Microsoft Copilot.

Enable this license item unless you disable SharePoint in Microsoft 365 and OneDrive.

claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least License Administrator or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses reaches user licence assignment.
claims.quote:
In the admin center, go to the Users > Active users page.
Select the row of the user that you want to assign a license to.
In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps.
Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns the selected licence using Microsoft Graph PowerShell.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.

Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: User licence assignment governs access to Copilot in OneDrive as a whole, not just the gallery.
claims.quote: Copilot is only available to users with a license assigned. If you remove the license from a user, the user loses access to Copilot.
